name: NOAA National Hurricane Center
summary: Keyless feeds of active Atlantic and Pacific tropical cyclones: a JSON summary of every active storm with links to its advisories, plus basin and per-storm RSS and GIS feeds.
notes: These are static files NHC updates with each advisory (typically every 6 hours, more often during landfall), not a query API: there are no parameters beyond the basin.
CurrentStorms.json has an empty activeStorms list outside active storms; field meanings are in NHC's Tropical Cyclone Status JSON File Reference (PDF on the product examples page).
Each storm entry in CurrentStorms.json links to its own products (public advisory, forecast discussion, cone and track GIS files); fetch those URLs directly.
RSS feeds are XML; storm wallets at1-at5, ep1-ep5, cp1-cp5 are slots NHC assigns to active storms in order.

endpoints.name: List active tropical cyclones
endpoints.summary: Every active storm with id, name, classification, intensity, pressure, position, movement and links to its latest products.

endpoints.name: Get a basin's advisories feed
endpoints.summary: RSS of the latest tropical weather outlooks and storm advisories for one ocean basin.

basin.description: at (Atlantic), ep (Eastern Pacific) or cp (Central Pacific).

endpoints.name: Get a basin's GIS feed
endpoints.summary: RSS linking the latest GIS files (forecast cone, track, wind field, watches/warnings) for a basin's storms.

basin.description: at (Atlantic), ep (Eastern Pacific) or cp (Central Pacific).

endpoints.name: Get a storm wallet feed
endpoints.summary: RSS of all products for the storm assigned to one wallet slot.

wallet.description: Basin and slot, e.g. at1 for the first active Atlantic storm.
